title: Prompt-State Coverage Auditor
purpose: Distinct from ad06e2e2 (cross-shot sequence gate) and acda5f8b (field-format gate). Tests whether a shot's render prompt textually covers the states the ledger record mandates — costume_note, location, character name — before the prompt is sent to an image-to-video engine. Source basis: art_01M6H5ADPZ1P46TM3CRGGYVTJK r3 Stage 3 check ("first-frame rules as states a still can show") and art_01M6A19D9WCBJFN6YNNXNTP570 r2 (colour-state rule that slipped between prompt and output stills). Baseline: an empty or partial prompt scores 0 covered fields; a fully stated prompt scores all required fields. Observable delta is the coverage ratio, not subjective quality.
